info.name: Apache HTTPD RCE via mod_whatever
info.description: Remote code execution in Apache HTTPD via a crafted mod_whatever request.
info.remediation: Upgrade Apache HTTPD to 2.4.59 or later.

info.name: Exposed login panel
info.description: A login page appears to be directly reachable from the Internet.

info.name: Server version disclosed in response headers
info.description: The server advertises its exact build in a response header, which narrows an attacker's search for applicable exploits.
info.remediation: Suppress the version banner in the server configuration.
